endoluten.labelDirections: Adults take 1 capsule once every 3 days, in the morning or at midday, for a course of about 20 days to 2 months.
endoluten.timing: in the morning or at midday
endoluten.contraindications: individual intolerance to the components, pregnancy, breastfeeding

cartalax.labelDirections: Adults: take 1–2 capsules 1–2 times a day with meals. Duration of use: 10–30 days. A repeat course is advisable after 4–6 months.
cartalax.courseDuration: 10–30 days; repeat course advisable after 4–6 months
cartalax.contraindications: individual intolerance to the components; consult a doctor first if pregnant, breastfeeding or with an ongoing condition
